name: 60527 · Burr Ridge, IL
findings: ZIP 60527 (Burr Ridge) has 198 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60527 (Burr Ridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60527 (Burr Ridge) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
